Package frc.robot.utils.targeting

Class TurretAngleTrims

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.utils.targeting.TurretAngleTrims
public final class TurretAngleTrims extends Object
Per-turret-angle shot corrections. The kicker and the turret put different spin on the ball depending on which way the turret points relative to the robot, so the same solved shot lands short or to one side at some turret angles. This table holds a range trim and an aim trim at POINTS turret angles spaced SPACING_DEG apart, starting at -180 (the front of the robot), and interpolates linearly between them, wrapping at +/-180.

Turret angles use the TurretAngles convention: clockwise-positive, 0 = back of robot.

      Interpolates the trims at a turret angle.
      Parameters:
      turretAngleDeg - turret angle (any range; wrapped into [-180, 180))

      yawTrimDeg - POINTS aim trims, degrees, at angleOfPoint(int)
